title: vaultOtpRoute
responsibility: Routes a Credential Vault one-time-code challenge to TOTP, SMS, email or device confirmation.

inputs.name: vaultOtpRoute.challenge
inputs.description: The challenge kind the site presented and when it was issued.

outputs.name: vaultOtpLimits
outputs.description: TOTP step length, the phone entry window and the attempt limit.

outputs.name: vaultOtpRoute
outputs.description: Phone TOTP, a sealed phone entry for SMS or email, a trusted-device confirmation, or a stop with its reason.
